spatial_sc_rnaseq_integration.sc_rnaseq_: Array[ScRnaseqProject] — typically one entry (cross-team cohort). Each entry: { asap_team_id, asap_dataset_id, asap_dataset_doi_url, final_adata_object (File), final_metadata_csv (File), scanvi_cell_types_parquet (File), raw_data_bucket, staging_data_buckets }
spatial_sc_rnaseq_integration.spatial_vi: Array[SpatialVisiumProject] (optional, default = []) — each entry: { asap_team_id, asap_dataset_id, asap_dataset_doi_url, samples (Array[SpatialVisiumSample]), raw_data_bucket, staging_data_buckets }. SpatialVisiumSample: { sample_id (String), qc_adata_object (File) } — from spatial_visium preprocess.qc_adata_objects
spatial_sc_rnaseq_integration.spatial_ge: Array[SpatialGeomxProject] (optional, default = []) — each entry: { asap_team_id, asap_dataset_id, asap_dataset_doi_url, samples (Array[SpatialGeomxSample]), raw_data_bucket, staging_data_buckets }. SpatialGeomxSample: { sample_id (String), processed_adata_object (File) } — from spatial_geomx process_to_adata.processed_adata_objects
